title: Exact T0 four-expert update with a frozen cached head

training_method.label: Frozen-head sparse-expert update
training_method.description: Train the router, shared trunk, and four experts while the final norm and untied output head remain immutable.

execution_topology.label: Coordinator-routed independent expert workers
execution_topology.description: The coordinator computes shared hidden rows and routing; each local worker returns one expert gradient and selected-row input adjoints.

memory_profiles.label: In-process CPU FP32 accounting
memory_profiles.description: Centralized and distributed models execute locally in one process; tensor payload fields are exact byte accounting rather than observed network traffic.

numerical_profiles.label: Python CPU FP32 exact control
numerical_profiles.description: One-thread PyTorch FP32 execution compares raw and clipped gradients, AdamW tensors, complete model tensors, loss, and routing exactly.

worker_profiles.label: Local in-process expert worker
worker_profiles.description: A copied expert and frozen head execute one selected token partition without authentication, process isolation, or network transport.

command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run python -m orcacolony.sparse_expert --config campaign/t0-smoke.json --expert-count 4 --router-aux-weight 0.01 --frozen-cached-head --output .artifacts/p7-cached-head-primary.json

OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run python -m orcacolony.sparse_expert --config campaign/t0-smoke.json --expert-count 4 --router-aux-weight 0.01 --frozen-cached-head --output .artifacts/p7-cached-head-repeat.json
